pagerduty: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=kv-cache-read | severity=high | trigger=tail_latency_p99 > 1200ms
pagerduty: incident link: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/INC-73921 | triggered at 1938456789

incident-bot: page fired to rotation (oncall: mike_oncall) :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: acked, i'm on it. pinging infra and checking recent deploys.

sara_dev: i'm pulling traces and logs now, looks like a short burst across us-west-2 region. will post snippets.

nina_sre: seeing p95/p99 spike on redis-proxy-0..3 pods, CPU low but io wait high. attaching tail of proxy logs:
```
2026-03-14T01:33:10Z redis-proxy[pid=67] WARN prefix_miss_ratio=0.78 latency_ms=1350 req_id=tx-9a3
2026-03-14T01:33:12Z redis-proxy[pid=67] WARN backend_conn_stalls=3 latency_ms=1490 req_id=tx-9b4
2026-03-14T01:33:13Z redis-proxy[pid=68] WARN prefix_miss_ratio=0.79 latency_ms=2100 req_id=tx-9c5
```

alex_ml: high prefix_miss_ratio makes me think a cache churn/cold-start. any autoscaler activity? could be a thundering cold-miss.

nina_sre: checking HPA events...
```
$ kubectl describe hpa redis-proxy -n prod
Events:
  01:31:29 scaling to 3 from 3 (current utilization below target)
  01:33:05 scaling to 6 from 3 triggered by custom-metric kv-cache-miss-rate
```

mike_oncall: ok manual mitigation: scaling replica count to 8 to absorb burst
```
kubectl scale deploy/redis-proxy -n prod --replicas=8
```

incident-bot: page acknowledged by mike_oncall :white_check_mark:

sara_dev: after scale replicas=8, p99 dropped back under 300ms within ~45s. no increased 5xx for customer-facing routes in logs. posting metrics snapshot: p99 210ms, errors 0.02% (baseline 0.01%).

pagerduty: Alert auto-resolved by policy (threshold cleared) at 1938456840. Note: auto-resolve after sustained below-threshold for 4m.

mike_oncall: confirmed resolved. seems transient cache churn + slow prewarming on redis-proxy leading to tail latency.

sara_dev: customer impact assessment: no customer retries or escalations observed, a handful of user-side client latencies briefly elevated but no failures. marking impact as "no customer-visible failure; latency blip".

nina_sre: I'll follow up with a config change proposal: increase HPA cooldown and add a small prewarm job when rolling restarts happen. also propose alert to include replica scaling events to reduce noise.

mike_oncall: agree. I'll create a short runbook ticket and tag infra/product for potential caching tuning. I'll handoff to night oncall @nina_sre for watches. leaving notes in the incident channel. :thumbsup:

nina_sre: taking overnight watch. will keep the autoscaler cooldown change in draft PR.

sara_dev: adding eval job to generate synthetic warm prefixes to avoid cold-thundering on deploys.

mike_oncall: closing thread here, will link follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2145. good catch team.

incident-bot: thread closed by mike_oncall at 1938456860
